files.README.md:
# Billing platform workspace

billing-reconciler replays settlement batches against the ledger and repairs
entries whose amounts disagree. Runtime settings live in the service settings
file; the deployment overlay under deploy/ carries the per-environment values.
files.services/billing-reconciler/settings.yam:
service_name: billing-reconciler
listen_port: 8612
max_inflight_batches: 12
retry_backoff_ms: 500
settlement_grace_minutes: 30
telemetry_sample_rate: 0.2
files.deploy/billing-reconciler.yaml:
service: billing-reconciler
environment: production
# Overrides applied at deploy time; unlisted keys keep the service settings value.
overrides:
  max_inflight_batches: 18
  telemetry_sample_rate: 0.05
files.ops/audit-checklist.md:
# Reconcile audit checklist, 2026-07-30
